notes: יָסַף is rule 56's adverbially rendered auxiliary verb, taking again while the infinitive holds the lexical predicate.
The לְ before הֵרָאֹה is unrepresented: the recasting writes the infinitive as the finite appeared with no function word before it (rules 40, 52).
himself renders the Niphal's own voice and stays with the verb rather than being marked added (rule 44).
